ayahs.1: Noon, qasam hai qalam ki aur is ki jo kuchh ke woh (farishte) likhte hain.
ayahs.2: Tu apne Rabb ke fazl se deewana nahin hai.
ayahs.3: Aur be-shak tere liye be-intehaa ajr hai.
ayahs.4: Aur be-shak tu bahut bade (umda) akhlaaq par hai.
ayahs.5: Pas ab tu bhi dekh lega aur yeh bhi dekh lenge.
ayahs.6: Ke tum mein se kaun fitne mein pada hua hai.
ayahs.7: Be-shak tera Rabb apni raah se behakne walon ko khoob jaanta hai, aur woh raah-yafta logon ko bhi bakhoobi jaanta hai.
ayahs.8: Pas tu jhutlane walon ki na maan.
ayahs.9: Woh to chaahte hain ke tu zara dheela ho to yeh bhi dheele pad jaayen.
ayahs.10: Aur tu kisi aise shakhs ka bhi kaha na maanna jo zyada qasmein khaane wala.
ayahs.12: Bhalaai se rokne wala, hadd se badh jaane wala, gunahgaar.
ayahs.13: Gardan-kash, phir saath hi be-nasab ho.
ayahs.14: Is ki sarkashi sirf is liye hai ke woh maal wala aur beton wala hai.
ayahs.15: Jab is ke saamne hamari aayatein padhi jaati hain to keh deta hai ke yeh to aglon ke qisse hain.
ayahs.16: Hum bhi is ki soond (naak) par daagh denge.
ayahs.17: Be-shak hum ne inhein isi tarah aazma liya jis tarah hum ne baagh walon ko aazmaaya tha jab ke unhon ne qasmein khaayen ke subah hote hi is baagh ke phal utaar lenge.
ayahs.19: Pas is par tere Rabb ki jaanib se ek bala chaaron taraf ghoom gayi aur yeh so hi rahe the.
ayahs.20: Pas woh baagh aisa ho gaya jaise kati hui kheti.
ayahs.21: Ab subah hote hi unhon ne ek doosre ko awaazein deen.
ayahs.22: Ke agar tumhein phal utaarne hain to apni kheti par sawere hi sawere chal pado.
ayahs.23: Phir yeh sab chupke chupke yeh baatein karte hue chale.
ayahs.24: Ke aaj ke din koi miskeen tumhare paas na aane paaye.
ayahs.25: Aur lapke hue subah subah gaye. (Samajh rahe the) ke hum qaabu paa gaye.
ayahs.26: Jab unhon ne baagh dekha to kehne lage yaqeenan hum raasta bhool gaye.
ayahs.27: Nahin nahin, balke hamari qismat phoot gayi.
ayahs.28: Un sab mein jo behtar tha is ne kaha ke main tum se na kehta tha ke tum Allah ki pakeezgi kyun nahin bayaan karte?
ayahs.29: To sab kehne lage hamara Rabb paak hai, be-shak hum hi zaalim the.
ayahs.30: Phir woh ek doosre ki taraf rukh karke aapas mein malamat karne lage.
ayahs.31: Kehne lage haaye afsos! Yaqeenan hum sarkash the.
ayahs.32: Kya ajab hai ke hamara Rabb hamein is se behtar badla de de, hum to ab apne Rabb se hi aarzu rakhte hain.
ayahs.33: Yun hi aafat aati hai aur aakhirat ki aafat bahut badi hai. Kaash inhein samajh hoti.
ayahs.34: Parhezgaron ke liye un ke Rabb ke paas ne'maton wali jannatein hain.
ayahs.35: Kya hum musalmanon ko misl-e-gunaahgaaron ke kar denge?
ayahs.36: Tumhein kya ho gaya, kaise faisle kar rahe ho?
ayahs.37: Kya tumhare paas koi kitab hai jis mein tum padhte ho?
ayahs.38: Ke is mein tumhari man-maani baatein hon?
ayahs.39: Ya tum ne hum se kuchh qasmein li hain? Jo qayamat tak baaqi rahen ke tumhare liye woh sab hai jo tum apni taraf se muqarrar kar lo.
ayahs.40: In se poochho to ke in mein se kaun is baat ka zimmedar (aur dawedar) hai?
ayahs.41: Kya un ke koi shareek hain? To chahiye ke apne apne shareekon ko le aayen agar yeh sachche hain.
ayahs.42: Jis din pindli khol di jaayegi aur sajde ke liye bulaaye jaayenge to (sajda) na kar sakenge.
ayahs.43: Nigahein neechi hongi aur un par zillat-o-khwaari chha rahi hogi, halanke yeh sajde ke liye (is waqt bhi) bulaaye jaate the jab ke saheeh saalim the.
ayahs.44: Pas mujhe aur is kalaam ko jhutlane wale ko chhod de, hum inhein is tarah aahista aahista kheenchenge ke inhein maloom bhi na hoga.
ayahs.45: Aur main inhein dheel doonga, be-shak meri tadbeer badi mazboot hai.
ayahs.46: Kya tu un se koi ujrat chahta hai jis ke taawaan se yeh dabe jaate hain?
ayahs.47: Ya kya un ke paas ilm-e-ghaib hai jise woh likhte hon?
ayahs.48: Pas tu apne Rabb ke hukm ka sabr se (intezar kar) aur machhli wale ki tarah na ho ja jab ke is ne gham ki haalat mein dua ki.
ayahs.49: Agar ise is ke Rabb ki ne'mat na pa leti to yaqeenan woh bure haaloon mein chatiyal maidaan mein daal diya jaata.
ayahs.50: Ise is ke Rabb ne phir nawaaza aur ise nekokaaron mein kar diya.
ayahs.51: Aur qareeb hai ke kaafir apni tez nigaahon se aap ko phisla dein, jab kabhi Quran sunte hain aur keh dete hain yeh to zaroor deewana hai.
ayahs.52: Dar-haqeeqat yeh (Quran) to tamaam jahaan walon ke liye sarasar naseehat hi hai.
